howto.what_en: Starts a local claude-mem worker on Grok Bot, tracking transcripts per agent; when a real task starts, it supplies session-start context through MCP.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to install or configure claude-mem on Grok Bot, either locally or remotely.
